leadText:
Bewear's den (Japanese: キテルグマの巣 's nest) is an -exclusive location in the Alola region used by for shelter. It is located in a hollowed-out tree within the dense forests of Melemele Island.

It first appeared in First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!, where Jessie her while staying there. Similarly, James went on to catch his inside Bewear's den in The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!.

 
 
In The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!, due to the constant supplies of honey and alongside its secretive location, decided to use Bewear's den as their base of operations whilst in Alola. Team Rocket built their headquarters on the level above the den's entrance and completed their new base renovations in A Seasoned Search!.

In Some Kind of Laziness!, Jessie, James, and were forced to seek shelter in a cave after it began raining at the Ruins of Abundance. They revealed that they quite enjoyed Bewear's company and the comfy feeling of the den.

When Bewear picked Team Rocket up from Aether Paradise in Don't Ignore the Small Stufful!, she was reunited with her child, , and brought it back home.

In Show Me the Metal!, Bewear's den was overrun by a group of . The Hex Nut Pokémon melted their way through much of Team Rocket's electronic equipment, including the central control network. The Meltan then escaped after attacking Team Rocket with several attacks.

In League Offenders and Defenders!, Team Rocket was revealed to have constructed a hot spring next to the den, intending to use it to keep Bewear and Stufful occupied while the Rocket trio took part in the Manalo Conference.

In Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!, Team Rocket received an order from Giovanni to return to the due to their lack of achievements in Alola. Knowing their Pokémon wouldn't be happy at the HQ, Jessie and James decided to leave them at the den. Mimikyu and Mareanie was later both seen playing alongside Stufful.

In All Out, All of the Time!, Team Rocket crash-landed in the hot spring next to the den after being blasted off during the Pokémon Catch Adventure Race. They briefly reunited with Mimikyu and Mareanie, before receiving one of Bewear's traditional bear hugs as a greeting from her.
